item.title: Troops bust cache of 295 grenades in Lanao del Sur
item.description: Government troops dealt a massive blow to terror remnants in Iligan City, seizing 295 hand grenades in Barangay Piagolongan on March 11. The 55th Infantry Battalion operation significantly dismantled the Daulah Islamiya–Maute Group's arsenal, highlighting the seamless coordination between Joint Task Force ZAMPELAN and local community informants. The post Troops bust cache of 295 grenades in Lanao del Sur appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: Senior suspect caught in Oro buy-bust
item.description: Police arrested Danilo Macapayag, Northern Mindanao's top regional drug priority, during a violent buy-bust in Barangay Camaman-an. The 65-year-old suspect bit a police operative and attempted to swallow evidence before authorities seized 75 grams of suspected shabu valued at P510,000. Macapayag now faces multiple drug-related charges. The post Senior suspect caught in Oro buy-bust appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.
